name: @openclinxr/station-mouth-registry
purpose: Mouth-station registry: generated solver map, committed pin and run.

exportSummaries.Problem: Solver input: the unseated asset and the cue track it must satisfy.
exportSummaries.RegistryPin: Committed pin: exactly the solver id and version the registry resolves.
exportSummaries.RunOptions: Input for run: the unseated asset bytes plus the one operator-set target.
exportSummaries.RunResult: Seated bytes, the receipt note and the pinned solution that produced them.
exportSummaries.Solution: Solver output: scored frames plus the provenance the receipt records.
exportSummaries.loadPin: Committed pin the registry resolves before solving.
exportSummaries.loadPinnedSolver: Resolve the committed pin against the generated solver map.
exportSummaries.run: Run the mouth station on unseated GLB bytes.
exportSummaries.verifySolution: Re-run the pinned solver and fail when the persisted solution differs.
